# Flower Vault: Archival Botany & Specimen Vault

> Digital taxonomic archive and procedural botanical synthesis engine. A specimen vault for Gongbi-style floral plates, botanical telemetry, and archival vector exports.

- [Root](https://flower-vault.glassgallery.my.id/): Archival Botany Synthesis Engine and Specimen Vault
- [Documentation](https://flower-vault.glassgallery.my.id/docs.html): Technical Documentation & Specimen Protocol Monograph
